item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We are fighting for a legally binding prohibition because no one has the right to impose that future on humanity.

2. We cannot safely control a system more intelligent than every human. If superintelligent AI is built in the next 20 years, at least a billion people will die. We must prohibit its development before the catastrophe begins.

3. We reject the gamble of building superintelligent AI and hoping humanity survives. If it is developed within 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe killing at least a billion people. We need a binding prohibition now.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We are clear about what is at stake. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We are not talking about a distant thought experiment or a manageable technology failure. We are talking about mass death on a scale humanity has rarely faced, driven by systems more capable than any human and beyond meaningful control. That is why we are working for a legally binding prohibition on developing superintelligence. No company, government, or laboratory should be allowed to impose this catastrophe on the world. Prevention is the only responsible course, and the time to act is now.
